mapper.select: select sum(satisfaction_flag) from sys_evaluate where shop_id = #{shopId} and is_delete = 0

SELECT IF(u.`user_id` IS NULL, "用户已注销", u.`user_name`) AS userName, u.`avatar`, IF(s.`shop_id` IS NULL, "酒店已下架", s.shop_name) AS shopName, s.`title_img` AS titleImg, e.* FROM sys_evaluate e LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON e.`user_id` = u.`user_id` left join shops s on e.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE is_delete = 0 and e.evaluate_id = #{evaluateId}
